name: broker-class-method-matrix
goal: Register broker method cases for every declared initialization state while retaining sealed CLI and file-boundary assertions.

evidence: The broker retains sealed contract access and exact assigned-file boundaries. Its class contract declares five initialization states across five public methods; existing integration and failure assertions remain in those cases.
The manifest registers five method-by-state rows per method. The existing suite keeps its seven titles and moves shared disposable setup into the existing fixture.
On harbor-mbp-2 the revised working-tree suite passed 25 cases on one Vitest worker. Static discovery and contract validation found exactly 25 cases with no errors.
